test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'no error' as your answer.**

He is going / to be wash / the dishes.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**to be wash**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**wash**" is in the infinitive form, but it should be in the past participle form "**washed**" to match the auxiliary verb "**to be**".
 
• The correct sentence should be "*He is going to wash the dishes*."

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**He is going**", is grammatically correct.
 
• "**the dishes**", is also grammatically correct.
 
• "**No error**", is incorrect as there is an error in Option 3.
